annotations.title: Is M&A in this sector rising or falling, and who is doing it?

description: Use when the user asks about M&A activity, deal flow or consolidation in a sector, whether now is a good time to buy or sell a company in it, or who the active acquirers are. Returns, quarter by quarter, the 8-K merger-agreement documents that mention the sector as a share of all 8-K merger agreements, from SEC EDGAR full-text search, whether that share is rising or falling, an industry-code cross-check, and the most active filers with their latest filing linked. It counts documents, not deals, and gives no deal values or multiples. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/deal-activity.json

phrase.description: Your own sector phrase, without quote marks, if no named sector fits. Not with sector.

quarters.description: How many quarters, ending with the last complete one. Default 8.

sector.description: A named sector, with its phrase and industry codes set for you. Or give phrase instead.

sic.description: Optional, with phrase: four-digit SIC codes for the cross-check, comma-separated, e.g. "7372,7373".
